basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original reserve character animation PNG for Lane Battle. The attached original soldier and griffin sheets are DIRECT STYLE REFERENCES ONLY; replace their subjects with the specified new character. Match their chunky GBA pixel-art technique, navy outlines, compact proportions, square pixel clusters, restrained two-tone shading and small highlights. Strict RIGHT-facing side profile throughout, mirrored-game compatible. Muted dark fantasy palette; friendly teal/blue costume insignia, enemy rust-red/orange costume insignia; preserve material/element colors independently. Actual transparent alpha background, NO painted checkerboard, no background, ground shadows, text, labels, captions, borders, gradients, blur or antialiasing. Exactly SIX columns and SIX rows, 36 poses, equal cells, ample transparent separation. Row1 idle/hover loop. Row2 SIX distinct walking poses (alternating planted feet and passing poses) for ground characters OR proper wingbeat/hover travel for flying characters. Row3 attack/cast: anticipation, windup, release/strike, followthrough, recovery, ready. Row4 hit recoil then recovery, no red flash. Row5 stunned sway loop, grounded if ground, struggling lift if flyer. Row6 defeat collapse to rest for ground OR wings fold and falling for flyer. Rows1,2,5 loop;3,4,6 one-shot. Keep identical anatomy/equipment, pixel density and stable anchors in all36 cells. Ground feet baseline at88% cell height, body centered x50%; flying body centered50%,50%. Weapons and wings never touch cell edges. No large spell effects or projectiles baked into frames, only restrained hand/staff casting gestures. Small creatures occupy less of their cell than humanoids; heavy creatures occupy more without larger pixels.
